datasets.arm_or_class: AF donors vs non-AF control donors (left-atrial CM)

informativeness.reason: none of the 18092 measured genes is a DEG under the v2 definition (padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 2.0), so every gene ranks at n_DEG + 1 = 1 and the dataset carries no ordering evidence
informativeness.rule: a dataset is informative when it has at least one DEG under the v2 definition and its measured genes carry more than one distinct continuous effect score; a dataset with no DEG ranks every gene at n_DEG + 1 and a dataset whose measured effects are all tied ranks by gene_index alone, so either carries no ordering evidence (ADR 0068, kept by ADR 0071)

method.design: one joint fit ~0 + group over 34 donors

rejected.reason: left-atrial snRNA-seq (9 donors: 3 no-AF / 3 paroxysmal / 3 persistent) whose deposit ships NO author cell-type annotation — only per-sample CellRanger barcodes/features/matrix triples and an empty series-matrix data table. A CM gate would have to be invented from markers, which is forbidden, so the DEG step is not testable. This is a different accession from GSE269882, not an alias of it.

tiering.rule: the tier-stop criterion is the disease DEG union resolved to the frozen 18,164-gene axis (axis-resolved, not genome-wide): a source DEG off the axis cannot enter DEG2000 or any axis built from it, so it does not count toward the 2,000-gene stop test. Sources are collected in ascending tier order; a tier with no declared source is absent from the ladder (AF declares tier 1 and tier 3, no tier 2), and a category whose evidence begins at tier 2 (the cardiotox classes) enters there. The cumulative axis-resolved union is measured after each tier and collection stops at the first tier whose union reaches the limit; a declared source in a deeper tier after a completed tier that already reached the limit is refused rather than admitted. Only declared sources are collected, so a tier between two entered tiers is never back-filled.
